description.value:
When you alone would be affected by a weapon or force power that calls for a Dexterity save or an attack roll, you can use your reaction to send that effect toward a different target within 30 feet instead. If the effect required a melee or ranged attack roll, make that same kind of force attack against the new target; if it required a Dexterity save, the new target instead makes a Dexterity save against your universal force save DC.

You must complete a short or long rest before using this feature again.
